PRACTICAL QUESTIONS

Before you
move forward.

What does the €990 audit include?+

An assessment of 1 bar over 1 to 2 days on site and a report within 7 days after the visit, with 10 margin quick wins and implementation priorities. Travel is extra and agreed in advance. Prices exclude VAT. Implementation is commissioned separately.

What does a project include?+

It depends on the diagnosis and agreed scope. Work can include audits, menus, drink specifications, training, service routines and follow-up. The proposal sets out deliverables, timing, fees and responsibilities.

What results should we expect?+

We define indicators around your operation: contribution margin, average spend, waste, consistency or service times. Outcomes depend on demand, resources and execution; we do not guarantee profits or revenue increases.

Do you work in Portugal and Spain?+

These are our priority markets. Location, travel and availability are confirmed for each project. You can get in touch in Portuguese, Spanish or English.

Is the first meeting really free?+

Yes. There is no meeting fee or obligation to book. We confirm availability and location; any travel costs are agreed beforehand. The visit is an initial assessment. A detailed audit with a report, training or implementation requires a separate paid proposal.
